text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Just a little bit more!
I really feel like we're just a little bit away!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
However—
that "just a little more" is a massive wall to climb.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
do you know what I'm lacking right now?
choice_data_list: Alright, time for a review meeting!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
do you know what I'm lacking right now?
choice_data_list: Alright, time for a review meeting!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“...... I get it, coming from you.
You don't mean that just as hollow words of encouragement, do you?”
choice_data_list: I'm not on the wrong path.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I am only halfway along the path, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right.
Rushing now would only make us spin our wheels.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, let's keep this up!
We'll keep training steadily, and then—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'll overtake them and keep on running!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha! I love how quick you are on the uptake!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"That's right. Whatever we're missing,
we'll figure it out together!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I've got some homemade pickles. Let's munch on them while we review today's race!
